historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works' denial of a permit to alter the building at 1843-1849 Bush Street, with a condition for a handrail.
Redevelopment Agency inspectors recorded three apartments in a three-storey building. The interior was in poor condition. Assessed at $1,690 for the land and $4,000 for the improvements.

The Redevelopment Agency photographed it as sample no. 33 of its 50-building study of whether Western Addition Area Two's housing could be conserved rather than cleared, listing it as a building of five to nine dwellings.
The Redevelopment Agency sold the building at 1843-49 Bush Street back to its former owner for $58,000, on condition that it be rehabilitated.
